en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding an eye of a horse which was blinded (by someone), by a quarter of its price on the day its eye was blinded (price when horse had both eyes)’.
